BR_Salvagers.text: THE LAUNCH-SHOP / SALVAGERS — smart, clean, capable underdog engineers using maintained older-generation aerospace hardware, rugged adventure equipment and mid-to-late-20th-century retrofuturist forms. Solarwave warmth, canvas, brushed and painted metal, cream, ochre, rust-orange and practical dark accents. Their rockets and vehicles are not garbage piles: they are beautiful legacy machines kept flying through ingenuity.

BR_Aegis.text: AEGIS CORPORATION — wealthy current-generation aerospace monopoly. Brushed aluminum, carbon fiber, architectural white, graphite and black surfaces, precise seams, cyan instrumentation, drones, robotics and automated systems. Sleek and technologically dominant without borrowing the salvagers' retrofuturist language.

launch_shop.text: THE LAUNCH-SHOP — independent desert engineers building communications access for communities excluded by Aegis; maintained legacy aerospace, solarwave and rugged adventure design rather than junkyard improvisation.

aegis.text: AEGIS CORPORATION — orbital infrastructure monopoly; visually precise, clean, high-modern, technologically dominant, with brushed aluminum, carbon fiber and cyan system light.
